records.description: Won Silver Medal representing India at the Isshinryu World Karate Championship held in Pittsburgh, USA.
Achieved a world record when 1222 bikes passed over his chest in record time — a feat of mind-over-matter endurance.
Honoured with the prestigious title of Shihan, the highest teaching rank in Zen Isshinryu Karate.
Received the highest national Scout award from the President of India in recognition of exemplary discipline and service.
Since 2011, trained over 1,700 students in traditional karate, self-defense, and character development.
Personally mentored and produced more than 150 Black Belts and certified future instructors.
Promoting discipline, leadership, and self-defense education across schools, colleges, and corporate organizations.
Founded the academy in 2011 with an unwavering commitment to respect, discipline, and martial excellence.
